scope: matter workspace, evidence review, local document processing and per-user authorization

validated_features.individual_tokens: hashed at rest; bootstrap restricted; rotation and revocation tested
validated_features.matter_permissions: owner/editor/viewer; cross-user access denied; ownership transfer tested
validated_features.request_isolation: session and cancellation IDs namespaced by user; late answer blocked after access revocation
validated_features.document_storage: SQLite transactions; original bytes, extracted text, SHA-256 and page maps; immutable records; original downloads enforce ACL
validated_features.retrieval: local FTS5 prefix search; multiple documents; literal citation offsets and hashes
validated_features.edition_dossiers: quoted date boundaries; independent account approval; half-open periods; overlap ambiguity; revoked records excluded
validated_features.case_dossiers: identity and outcome quotes; same-case links; declared opposing/supporting positions; future events excluded
validated_features.human_benchmarks: independent account review; manual correctness and missed-risk scoring; duplicate evaluations rejected; revoked benchmarks excluded from metrics
validated_features.local_ocr: real image-only synthetic PDFs recognized in English and Russian
validated_features.docx_export: literal unique replacements with change protocol; readable by independent python-docx library
validated_features.redaction: local incomplete preview; never claims verified anonymization
validated_features.worker_cleanup: POSIX worker and converter child killed on deadline
validated_features.audit: append-only SQL triggers, metadata-only events, hash-chain verification

remaining: Acquire complete primary legislative texts and amendment/transition histories for the selected scope
Collect and independently assess individual court cases and their full procedural histories
Have qualified independent humans approve legal benchmark answers and apply the scoring rubric
Run real provider, browser and deployment acceptance
Prepare production TLS, backup/encryption and retention procedures
Semantic retrieval, automatic semantic grading, SSO and Word tracked changes are not implemented
